record.context_brief: volume threshold for convex planar boundary
record.original_question: Let C be a non-circular closed convex planar curve. Prove that there exists a constant V_C > 0, depending only on C, such that for every compact embedded constant-mean-curvature disk Sigma spanning C with volume V > 0, the following threshold behavior holds: if V <= V_C then Sigma lies on one side of the boundary plane P; if V = V_C then Sigma is tangent to P at the points of minimum curvature of C; and if V > V_C then Sigma has points on both sides of P.

evidence.quote: Problem 3.7 (4*). Let C be a non-circular closed convex planar curve. Prove that there is V_C > 0 depending only on C such that, if Sigma is a compact cmc embedded disk spanning C and with volume V > 0, it holds: (1) If V <= V_C, then Sigma lies in one side of P. (2) If V = V_C, then Sigma is tangent to P at the points of minimum curvature of C. (3) If V > V_C, then Sigma has points in both sides of P.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ be a non-circular, closed, smooth, convex planar curve lying in a plane $P \subset \mathbb{R}^3$. A compact embedded constant-mean-curvature (cmc) disk $\Sigma$ spanning $C$ is a compact embedded surface of disk type with $\partial\Sigma = C$ and constant scalar mean curvature, and its (algebraic) volume $V > 0$ is the volume enclosed between $\Sigma$ and the planar disk in $P$ bounded by $C$.

Prove that there exists a constant $V_C > 0$, depending only on $C$, with the following threshold behavior. For every compact embedded cmc disk $\Sigma$ spanning $C$ with volume $V > 0$:

(1) If $V \le V_C$, then $\Sigma$ lies entirely in one of the two closed half-spaces determined by $P$.

(2) If $V = V_C$, then $\Sigma$ is tangent to $P$ at the points of $C$ where the curvature of $C$ attains its minimum.

(3) If $V > V_C$, then $\Sigma$ contains points strictly on both sides of $P$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem (marked with a difficulty asterisk) in a problem list on cmc surfaces with planar boundary. A web search did not surface any published resolution: existing literature treats related results (Nitsche-type tangency, Alexandrov reflection, behavior over circular boundaries) but no source establishes the precise three-part volume threshold for general non-circular convex planar boundaries.

status_evidence.title: Compact constant mean curvature surfaces in Euclidean three-space
status_evidence.snippet: Studies compact cmc surfaces with planar boundaries; provides background but no statement of the volume threshold for non-circular convex boundaries.
status_evidence.claim: Related foundational results exist but do not establish the threshold V_C.

status_evidence.title: Constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary on a sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys cmc surfaces with prescribed boundary, including planar convex boundaries, without proving the asserted threshold behavior.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of the V_C threshold problem is reported.
